note: Universal item-filter rules. Content hygiene only — scope (Nepal relevance) stays in src/core/geo.js. Base-4 sources (sathijob, kumarijob, merojob, internsathi) skip ALL filters here; their extractors produce clean output and any change to posted items is regression risk. Each rule is one decision: drop the item, clear a field, strip bytes from a field, split a field into sections, fix bytes in a field, or flag for human review. Batch refine-filters phase proposes additions to this file from LLM analysis of real scraped items. Hand-edits are for one-off fixes with a stated reason in the rule's `reason` field.

patterns: sorry, there are no positions available at this time

rules.reason: Extractor scraped a 'no current roles' state message as if it were a job listing.

patterns: this role is no longer available

rules.reason: Short description that is entirely a 'role closed' message. Long descriptions that mention closure in passing are NOT dropped (guarded on length).

matcher.pattern: Mobile platform Web Platform Infrastructure Product, Project Management & Collaboration Product Design Our areas of interest #CloudComputing #SaaS #Kubernetes #DataEngineering #CloudStorage #DataWarehouse #ProductDesign #DistributedComputing #DeepLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #DataVisualization #MaterialDesign

rules.reason: Evolveasia footer/nav blob scraped as description content. Real job, bad description. Item survives with empty description.

matcher.pattern: We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can submit your CV for a position that you are interested in. Electronics and Mechanical Engineers, please apply at Yarsa Tech Jobs website.

rules.reason: Yarsalabs footer boilerplate. Strip wherever found; real role content (if any) is preserved.

matcher.pattern: We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can still send us your resume at careers@yarsalabs.com
We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can send your resume to careers@yarsalabs.com

rules.reason: Description is ENTIRELY a boilerplate prefix with no real content following. Clear rather than strip-to-empty (matches the intent: item survives, description becomes null).

matcher.pattern: Company Description: Teslatech is an independent mobile game developer based in Lalitpur, Nepal.

rules.reason: Teslatech company intro paragraph that appears as the first paragraph of every role.

matcher.pattern: Careers At NepTechPal " Join our teams of professional developers and marketers." Careers

rules.reason: Navigation labels that get scraped as pipe-delimited description fragments. Only removes them when they appear as standalone pipe segments — never inside prose.
Split run-on descriptions at known section headers. Content preserved verbatim; paragraph breaks inserted at each boundary.
German gender-notation suffix (f/m/d, m/f/d, f/m/x) is site chrome, not part of the role title.
Opening-count suffix appears as site data, not role title.
